quadrants.label: Borrowed biology
quadrants.blurb: Well studied elsewhere in biology, essentially new to lupus. The mechanism and often the tool compounds already exist — what is new is someone pointing them at this disease.

quadrants.label: Frontier
quadrants.blurb: Thinly studied anywhere, and what little lupus literature exists is nearly all recent. Highest risk, least crowded.

quadrants.label: Accelerating classics
quadrants.blurb: Familiar proteins with a real pre-existing lupus literature that the field has returned to sharply in the last five years.

quadrants.label: Quiet climbers
quadrants.blurb: Small literatures in general, with lupus interest building steadily on top of an earlier base.
